name: Iván Benito Sánchez

en.tagline: I build data solutions on Microsoft Fabric: from source to Lakehouse and Warehouse, with reliable, traceable data.
about: Data Engineer specializing in Microsoft Fabric, with a background in Business Administration and Business Analytics, certified as a Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate.
I design and build data solutions on Fabric: Lakehouse, Data Warehouse and OneLake, data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes with Data Factory, SQL and PySpark, and dimensional data modeling.
I am currently part of the Data Engineering team at CEF.-UDIMA. I care about data being reliable, traceable and high-quality, and about the business actually using it to make decisions.

headline: Data Engineer | Microsoft Fabric | SQL · PySpark · ETL/ELT
tagline: Construyo soluciones de datos en Microsoft Fabric: del origen al Lakehouse y al Warehouse, con el dato fiable y trazable.
about: Data Engineer especializado en Microsoft Fabric, con formación en ADE y Business Analytics y certificado como Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate.

Diseño y desarrollo soluciones de datos en Fabric: Lakehouse, Data Warehouse y OneLake, pipelines y procesos de integración, transformación y carga (ETL/ELT) con Data Factory, SQL y PySpark, y modelado dimensional de los datos.
Actualmente formo parte del equipo de Ingeniería del Dato de CEF.-UDIMA. Me importa que el dato sea fiable, trazable y de calidad, y que el negocio lo use de verdad para decidir.
